comment: Roof colour families for aerial roof colours (CIE L*a*b*, D65, from uncalibrated NAIP sRGB). Classification rules only, applied in order by roofcore.colour_family: chroma below achromaticMaxChroma (or inside an achromaticHues sector below its chroma limit) -> achromatic band by L*; otherwise the first chromatic rule whose hue sector [from, to) (degrees, may wrap through 0), minChroma and L* limits match. renderHex are suggested roof-slot colours per family for a generator palette (ground-level material look, not the aerial appearance). Hand-written before any labelling (assumption), not fitted.

darkAchromatic.comment: added after inspecting aggregate output, before any scoring: very dark NAIP roofs carry a blue cast (5 roofs at median L* 18, b* -8 were classed blue); version 1 without this rule is reported too

achromaticHues.comment: slight magenta casts on grey roofs

sceneRelative.comment: Rule set 2 (designed on labelled sample A after its scoring, validated on the fresh sample B): grey-world white balance on roofs. neutral = median a*, b* of all estimated roofs in the scene; relative chroma and hue are measured from that neutral. NAIP roof chroma is very low (C* 2-7), so the absolute rules above call almost every warm roof grey or charcoal.
